title: Private Discussions: Lawsuit, Land, Staff
summary:
*   A special meeting was held, almost entirely conducted in a private executive session.
*   The closed-door discussions covered ongoing litigation, potential land acquisitions, and personnel matters.
*   Specifically, the "City of Austin v. Houston Lighting and Power" lawsuit was a key topic.
*   No public votes or final policy decisions were made during this brief meeting.
